branchpilot.config.protection.mode: When to ask for confirmation before operations that modify code or could lose work.
branchpilot.config.protection.mode.all: Ask for confirmation before operating on any branch.
branchpilot.config.protection.mode.list: Ask for confirmation only on branches listed in protectedBranches.
branchpilot.config.protection.protectedB: Branches highlighted as protected (wildcard patterns like release/* allowed).
branchpilot.config.staleDays: Days of inactivity after which a branch is considered stale.
branchpilot.config.scanPaths: Absolute directory paths to scan for additional Git repositories in the Multi-Repo Radar.
branchpilot.config.worktree.copyIgnoredF: Git-ignored environment files automatically copied when creating a parallel worktree.
branchpilot.config.worktree.linkNodeModu: Create a symbolic link to node_modules in the new parallel worktree if present in the main repository.
branchpilot.config.autoGuard.enabled: Show a reactive alert when edits are detected on a protected branch (main/master), offering to move changes to a new task branch.
